samples.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers recommend a modular grid for clear reasons and handle stats in much the same strong way: hero numbers, charts only for comparisons, stats paired with stories, and context for every figure. B edges ahead because it says plainly where stats sit outside the text column (full-width bands, the margin or secondary column, aligned to the text edges), and its advice to vary the pacing across the six sections fits the request more closely. A's opening is a bit clearer and its module list is practical, but neither answer clearly names a downside of the grid it picks. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers recommend a modular grid with a capped reading measure and give strong, similar advice on stats (hero numbers, charts only for comparisons, pairing stats with stories). B also adds reusable modules and responsive column counts. Neither answer names a real downside of the modular grid itself, though A's note about print columns needing to add up exactly touches on its added complexity.
